Your goal is to identify if any web server processes are currently running in the workspace.

Specifically, check for processes related to:
- nginx
- apache (httpd)
- node (Node.js servers)

Provide a summary of which web server processes, if any, are currently active.

None of the provided functions can be used to check for running web server processes. They are all related to file system operations, browser automation, Notion API interactions, or SQL queries, and none of them can be used to inspect the current processes running on the system.
